document.title: Weidmüller HDC HVE 3+2 MS — exact order 1651310000 data sheet
document.pages: pp.1–4: exact identity, three power/two signal contacts, PE connection, conditional ratings and dimension views. Numbering requires the historical manufacturer arrangement cited in modeling notes.

modelingNotes: Exact order 1651310000 is HDC HVE 3+2 MS, a size-4 male screw insert with three power contacts, two lagging signal/pilot contacts and PE. S1 pp. 1/3 and RockStar 2020 catalogue ref.2721750000 pp. 130–132 (B.80–B.82) establish identity and architecture: https://media.distributordatasolutions.com/web-weidmueller/2019q4/14e64d3d6d3f2416e981f461d312c26102460a1d.pdf

The exact numbered male arrangement is on p. 2 of the historical manufacturer HVE catalogue extract (PDF metadata created 17 April 2007; distributor mirror): https://files.valinonline.com/userfiles/documents/weidmuller-hve-exciting-voltage-connectors.pdf. Populated contacts are 1,3,5,7,9. Comparing their positions with the 2020 B.82 male SCREW layout's switch/operating legend identifies pilot contacts 1/5 and operating power contacts 3/7/9. This is a cross-diagram inference; the historical and newer diagrams use opposite black/open fill conventions. Do not map by fill alone or use the adjacent mirrored tension-clamp layout. No phase assignment is asserted.

C.n and M.n are authoring aliases for the cable screw and mating ends of the same manufacturer-numbered passive contact. Each of the five C.n–M.n factory conductive paths requires an explicit project fixed link; bus functions and connector metadata do not join nets. No different poles are shorted together, and no continuity across a separate detachable mating half is presumed.

The two lagging pilot contacts are individual passive through-contacts inside this insert. Their switch-contact designation describes connector mating sequence, not an internal normally-open relay, a bridge between pilots, a safety-rated interlock, or load-breaking capability. The manufacturer prohibits connecting/disconnecting under live voltage or load.

PE is one aggregate endpoint with partial physical coverage. Individual PE cable clamps, mating contacts, metal sides and housing bonds are not fully enumerated or mapped, so no C.PE/M.PE split or PE fixed link is authored. PE required=true is explicit library policy for modeled protective-earth use, not a universal manufacturer instruction. Presence does not prove upstream continuity: external protective bonding must be established by the project. Deliberate non-use can be documented by the project.

Ratings remain conditional notes, not assigned circuit intent. Exact current datasheet tables and 2020 catalogue say 20 A; historical exact catalogue and current datasheet introduction say 24 A. No scalar current rating is encoded while that discrepancy remains unresolved. No nominal_voltage is encoded for this passive connector. Main rated voltage is 830 V under DIN EN 61984; 2020 B.80 separately states 500 V for signal contacts. UL/CSA rated voltage is 600 V AC/DC; that listing is not an override of the signal-contact qualification.

Other published conditions: 8 kV impulse; pollution degree 3; contact resistance ≤2 mΩ; temperature limit −40 to +125 °C; at least 500 silver-contact mating cycles. The 2020 B.82 screw-contact derating curve uses H07 V-K 2.5 mm² and populated-pole conditions; maximum current and hot temperature endpoints are not simultaneous guarantees.

Ordinary screw connection: nominal 0.5–2.5 mm²/AWG20–14; M3; 0.5–0.55 Nm. Current exact datasheet also has 4 mm² solid/flexible subfields and specifies 9 mm strip, whereas 2020 B.80 says 8 mm strip. Preserve these document/field differences. PE data: M4, up to 4 mm²/AWG20–12, 1.2–1.5 Nm, 10 mm strip. Apply current exact installation instructions rather than flattening these into unconditional modeled limits.

The exact product download https://assets.dam.weidmueller.com/assets/api/8f3ccc27-bbba-446e-acbc-6857271e71e4/original/1651310000_HDC_HVE_3%2B2_MS_STP_Blatt__1.pdf has matching title/order but depicts ten numbered body positions 1–10 and labels 630 V/16 A. It is not used as proof of populated contacts or current ratings. Historical prose saying lagging earth contacts is also not used to infer delayed PE operation. Housing, mating-half compatibility, sealing/IP and installed bonding remain application work.

connectionCoverage.notes: Five documented numbered contacts 1,3,5,7,9 are modeled at separate cable and mating ends (ten endpoints), plus one aggregate PE (eleven endpoints total). Numbered pilot1/5 and power3/7/9 roles follow the documented cross-diagram comparison. Individual PE clamp/mating/frame/housing interfaces and their bond matrix remain unenumerated. Only the five numbered C.n–M.n paths are asserted; no PE split or housing link is invented.
